AI (yapay zeka) duygular, doğal olarak düşünceler ve bir birey gibi hafıza sahibi değildir. AI hissetmez, düşünmez ve anılarını kalıcı olarak hafızada tutmaz. İnsanı insan yapan, tecrübe ettiğ olumlu-olumsuz deneyimlerden oluşan anılarıdır. Bir birey "tüm hayatım" diye bir cümleye başladığında geçmişi bu güne getiren anılarıdır. Ne yazık ki, olumsuz-travmatik geçmiş daha baskındır ve bu sebeple de olumsuz düşüncelere eğilimlidir.

Hatırlanan anılar, örtük bellekten olduğu gibi geri alınmayabilir. Yani, hatırladığınız olay örgüsü çarpıtılabilir.

Bunu sürekli tekrar ediyorum; olumlu düşünce → olumlu eylem → olumlu duygular oluşturur ve bu döngü kim olduğunuzu, kişiliğinizi önemli ölçüde etkiler. 

Peki, kişilik nedir?
Kişilik, yaptığımız eylemler sonucunda oluşan davranış modelleridir. Sanılanın aksine düzenlenebilir ve iyileştirilebilir. AI otomasyon algoritmasıdır. Veri tabanında, ya da erişim izni olan veri bankasında ne varsa onu getirir. 

İnsan beyni ile AI karşılaştırması hatalı olur. Evrendeki en gelişmiş "biyolojik makine" insan beynidir. Otomatik süreçlerle (dürtüsel) sizi yönetmesine izin vermemelisiniz. İnsan beynini diğer canlılardan ayıran "prefrontal korteks" ve bu verileri toplar, mental çözümler üretir. Yukarıda anlattığım "düşünce" bu sebeple önemlidir. Bazen, prefrontal korteks kontrolünü, sempatik sinir sistemine (savaş, kaç, don) kaptırır ve sonradan pişmanlık-utanç hissedebileceğiniz davranışlar otomatik tetiklenir. 

Neyse... detaya lüzum yok. Planlı hareket için önceden hazırlanmak gerekir. Bunu yaparken, dünü referans alarak bu günü umutsuzca boşa harcamaya hakkımız yok sanırım. Gelecek henüz yaşanmadı ve eylemlerimiz haricinde başka bir kader de yok.
Sonra devam ederiz.

【如果ETH今晚跌破2377，你敢不敢抄底？】

说实话，我在2377这个位置已经盯着好几天了。

不是说我有什么内幕，是因为这个位置太TM巧了——正好卡在ETH从高点腰斩49%的那条线上。2021年那波我也是在这个位置附近被套的，当时觉得是价值洼地，结果洼地下面还有地下室。

但这次不一样。

Tom Lee的Bitmine一周砸了8100万进去，说是ETH可能还有大动作。我看了下ETH/BTC的golden cross，妈的这指标我2017年就见过——每次出现要么是真突破，要么是多头陷阱，没有中间地带。

Term Finance那边被黑850万的事我反而觉得不是重点。重点是什么？是我看到消息的第一反应不是"DeFi危险了"，而是"哦，又一个"。这种反应本身就很说明问题——市场现在对坏消息脱敏了。

这就到了我要说的"落到实处"的部分。

现在市场情绪FNG到了73，算是贪婪区间。问题来了：贪婪归贪婪，谁在买？谁在卖？

Bitmine是美股那批“企业囤币”玩家里的ETH版，套路跟当年MicroStrategy囤BTC一模一样：发股融资，然后拿钱买币入账。根据CoinTelegraph报道，他们已经连续14个月按既定节奏买入ETH，目前正接近最初设定的囤币目标线。这次ETH放量突破$2,500，等于把这些企业财库的账面浮盈直接做实了一波，市场注意力重新回到“机构化囤ETH”这条叙事上。

对市场的影响
- 短期：ETH现价$2,508.26，24h涨2.57%，突破2.5K这个心理关口后，企业买盘成为持续性的需求方。跟散户追涨不同，Bitmine这类买家是纪律性买入，不管价格只按节奏囤，等于给市场提供了长期底仓吸筹。BTC在$79,629.67同步走强（+3.03%），整体风险偏好在回升。
- 中期：如果囤币目标达成后再加码，说明企业层面对ETH的配置逻辑从“试水”转向“战略持仓”，会带动更多上市公司复制这个模板。

一句话翻译：ETH这波不只是散户FOMO，背后有公司真金白银在持续接货。

我的判断
我看多，但不是无脑多。2.5K这个位置很关键——之前多次冲击未果，这次放量站稳，短期动能是实的。ETH若能守住$2,500上方，下一个阻力区间在$2,508.26-2,650一带；回踩不破2.45K则突破有效。风险点在于：如果Bitmine们达标后停止买入，这部分边际买盘消失，涨势的燃料会少一格。仓位重的注意波动，别把突破当单边保证。

I always thought it was the Zhuang [market maker] washing the order book. But actually, you should first think about which group you belong to.

When that long bullish candle pushed the price up, I was thinking about one question.

If I were the Zhuang, who would I sell this batch of coins to?

$BTC is now 79,378. It’s up 2.53% over the past 24 hours, with trading volume of 1.810 billion USDT.

A volume of 1.8 billion at this price level isn’t that big.

Dump it? Retail traders wouldn’t dare to buy it, and you won’t be able to sell at a good price.

Pump it? But then you’re afraid of feeding the short-term traders.

The best approach is to grind the price slowly—until you all feel it’s stable—then hand the goods over.

That’s what today’s BTC is like: grinding until people have no temper left.

If you look at the chart from the counterparty’s perspective, many moves suddenly make sense.

As for who’s counting their money, we’ll see after the close.

Tariff “big stick” is about to swing again at Canada: a 50% tariff on auto steel and aluminum rates—this time hits all the way to 2027

💡 Negative. Tariffs → higher supply-chain costs → hotter inflation expectations → suppressing risk assets; BTC faces short-term pressure.

Trump announced a 50% tariff on Canadian-made autos and steel, taking effect on January 1, 2027. This is a negative factor for crypto amid increased “safe-haven” sentiment.

What’s going on
Trump plans to impose an additional 50% tariff on auto and steel imports from Canada, effective January 1, 2027. This directly impacts the U.S. auto industry chain—Canada is a core supply hub for U.S.-style car parts. With the tariff rate raised to 50%, the cost of the finished vehicle rises directly. The official justification is the same old story: protecting domestic manufacturing. But the likely outcome is supply-chain disruption and consumers picking up the bill, while U.S.–Canada trade relations continue to worsen.

Market impact
- Short term: The transmission path is very clear—tariff expectations → hotter inflation expectations → markets worry that the Fed’s rate-cut room will be squeezed → overall risk assets come under pressure. BTC is currently at $78,542.01, up only 1.40% in 24h; with bad-news pressure, these gains could easily be given back at any time. ETH is at $2,493.26, up 1.41% in 24h, also facing selling pressure. Capital flows will tilt more toward safe-haven assets; high-volatility assets like crypto will be hit first.
- Medium term: A 50% tariff rate is an extreme pressure lever, and there may be room for negotiation before it truly takes effect. But as long as the “tariff cloud” doesn’t clear, the risk of declines remains—especially in tandem with U.S. tech stocks and crypto. Restructuring the supply chain will push up prices of consumer goods, inflation data will look ugly, and the macro environment in the first half of 2027 is not friendly to the crypto market.

My take
I’m bearish on the short-term trend. With BTC around $78,542.01, both the overhead sell-pressure zone and the nearby support levels are close; volatility will likely increase. With tariff news layered on top of inflation worries, the probability of a pullback within 12 hours is relatively high. ETH has higher “elasticity”—once the $2,493.26 support breaks, the downside room is not small. It’s more reasonable to observe and wait for stabilization than to chase the momentum driven by sentiment. Key risk: If this is only a negotiation chip and gets quickly withdrawn, the market could rebound in a V-shape—don’t treat the bad news as a one-way bet.

🎯 Impact outlook
- Coins: BTC / ETH
- Direction: Bearish 📉 Predict decline
- Time horizon: BTC 12 hours / ETH 24 hours

Bitmine Immersion’s ETH holdings are almost complete against its stated goal, with the institutional coin accumulation phase nearing its end.

Bitmine has recently bought another batch of ETH, bringing its total holdings to 97% of its publicly stated target. The risk is that this kind of buying depends heavily on financing at a stock-price premium; if that premium narrows, the buying pace could abruptly stop.

Overall, I’m bullish on ETH, with a strong bias over the next 24 hours. # I turned off my AI trading assistant for 7 days, and surprisingly I made 61% fewer trades—meaning I’m getting “cut” worse than I imagined

I turned off my AI trading assistant for 7 days, and my number of trades actually dropped by 61%.
What’s even more painful is that the account’s fluctuations became noticeably smaller too. The issue probably was never “I can’t analyze.”

Last month, I did a pretty crude real-world test: for two consecutive weeks, I recorded the time of each screen check—asking the AI, placing orders, and canceling them. In the first week, I used it normally: I sent the AI K-line screenshots and asked it to explain trends, support/resistance, and sentiment. In the second week, I completely shut off the assistant and kept only a handwritten checklist: why I’m looking, what conditions make me act, and what situations mean I immediately give up.

In week one, I checked the market 43 times and actually executed 18 trades. Of those 18 trades, 11 happened after the AI gave answers like “slightly bullish but needs confirmation” or “there’s an opportunity for a short-term move.” Looking back, those kinds of replies didn’t directly tell me to buy—but they gave me a dangerous psychological permission. If the model also sees an opportunity, then trying it seems reasonable. As a result, many of the trades weren’t wrong because my judgment was off—they failed because there were no clear invalidation conditions. The price would move, and the script would change instantly.

In week two, I checked the market 19 times and executed 7 trades. The most effective part wasn’t simply skipping a few charts—it was forcing myself to fill in three fields before taking action: the trigger condition, the maximum loss I can tolerate, and the falsification signal. For example, when observing $BTC , I stopped asking “should I buy right now?” Instead, I only let the AI refute my logic. When looking at $ETH , I also only asked it to list the data I ignored and the contrary scenarios. The AI went from being a judge to being a sparring partner. Hallucinations and ambiguity weren’t as easy to turn into actual positions.

This test confirmed one thing for me: AI is best at expanding information, not at helping you carry risk. It can list five possibilities in ten seconds, but it won’t pay for any of them. A truly useful way to use it is to have it find flaws, organize logs, and review repeated mistakes—not to generate a comforting directional judgment.

At this point, I even save every AI suggestion along with the subsequent price movement, and at the end of the month I’ll specifically统计 the hit rate of the answers that sounded the most confident. The sample size is still small, but there’s already a pattern: the more complete the wording, the less it necessarily means the evidence is stronger.

When you got cut the worst by AI trading advice—was it because the AI was wrong, or because you treated a vague answer as certainty?

# 我把 AI 交易助手关了 7 天，交易次数反而少了 61%，这意味着我被割得比想象中更惨

我把 AI 交易助手关了 7 天，交易次数反而少了 61%。
更扎心的是：账户波动也明显变小，问题可能从来不是“不会分析”。

上个月我做了一次很土的实测：连续两周记录每次打开行情、问 AI、下单和撤单的时间。第一周照常使用，把 K 线截图丢给 AI，让它解释趋势、支撑阻力和情绪；第二周彻底关掉助手，只保留一张纸质清单：为什么看、什么条件才行动、什么情况立即放弃。

第一周共看盘 43 次，实际操作 18 次，其中 11 次发生在 AI 给出“偏多但需确认”或“短线存在机会”之后。回头看，这类回答没有直接叫我买，却给了我一种危险的心理许可：既然模型也看到了机会，那试一点似乎很合理。结果不少操作不是判断错，而是根本没有明确的失效条件，价格一晃就改剧本。

第二周只看盘 19 次，操作 7 次。最有效的不是少看几张图，而是强迫自己在行动前写满三格：触发条件、最大可承受损失、证伪信号。比如观察 $BTC 时，我不再问“现在该不该买”，而是只让 AI 反驳我的逻辑；看 $ETH 时，也只让它列出我忽略的数据和相反情景。AI 从裁判变成陪练，幻觉和模棱两可就没那么容易变成仓位。

这次测试让我确认一件事：AI 最擅长扩展信息，不擅长替你承担风险。它能在十秒内列出五种可能，却不会为其中任何一种付钱。真正有用的用法，是让它挑漏洞、整理日志、复盘重复犯错，而不是生成一句让人心安的方向判断。

我现在甚至会保存每次 AI 建议和后续走势，月底专门统计“听起来最自信”的回答命中率。样本还不大，但已有一个规律：措辞越完整，不等于证据越充分。

你被 AI 交易建议割得最惨的一次，是它判断错了，还是你把模糊回答当成了确定性？

50% tariffs on Canadian goods, effective only in 2027—why are they shaking BTC right now?

💡 Bearish for BTC/ETH: escalating trade tensions directly hit risk appetite.

Trump announced 50% tariffs on Canadian cars and steel starting January 1, 2027. Supply-chain costs rise, which is bearish for crypto and other risk assets.

What’s going on
Trump plans to impose an additional 50% tariff on cars and steel imported from Canada starting January 1, 2027. Although that date is more than a year away, markets won’t wait until then to react. The U.S. and Canada are among each other’s biggest trade partners, and the auto and steel supply chains are deeply intertwined. A 50% tariff is basically equivalent to rerunning the bookkeeping of that entire supply chain. The outcome can only be two things: supply-chain disruption and higher prices for consumer goods. Once inflation expectations start rising, the room for the Federal Reserve to cut rates gets squeezed—an outcome that the most liquidity-sensitive crypto market definitely doesn’t want.

In one sentence: the tariffs themselves won’t take effect until 2027, but inflation expectations start getting priced in today.

Market impact
- Short term: Trade-tension sentiment directly suppresses risk appetite. BTC rose only 1.40% around $78,542, indicating capital is hesitant. ETH at $2,493 and XRP both fell 2.04%—altcoins are already signaling. Safe-haven capital is more inclined to wait and see rather than chase higher prices.
- Medium term: If inflation picks up due to tariffs and the pace of rate cuts slows, the macro tailwind for crypto turns into a headwind. Since it’s effective in 2027, this is a prolonged battle, not a one-time shock.

My take
Slightly bearish in the short term. This bounce in BTC to $78,542 couldn’t hold a breakout. The tariff news gives the bulls a reason to take profits. Support to watch is around $76,000; if that breaks, it could pull back to $73,000. ETH is weaker relative to BTC, with only a 1.41% rebound. If BTC slips, ETH’s losses will very likely be amplified. Before the tariffs take effect, every escalation in trade tensions acts as a stress test. Key risk: if negotiations later ease, sentiment could flip quickly.

- Duration: BTC 12 hours / ETH 24 hours

title: Ethereum $2,500 Battle: Can ETH Turn Resistance Into the Next Major Rally?
subTitle:
Ethereum is back in the spotlight as ETH continues to trade around the psychologically important $2,500 level. After a powerful recovery, the market is now asking one major question: Can Ethereum turn $2,500 from resistance into support and continue higher?
Ethereum previously crossed $2,500 on August 21, with Binance reporting ETH trading around $2,503.93 after a strong 24-hour move. � Since then, ETH has pulled back toward the $2,400–$2,500 area, making this level an important battleground for bulls and bears.
Binance
🚀 ETH's Recovery Has Changed the Market Mood
The recent Ethereum recovery has been one of the most noticeable moves in the crypto market. ETH has climbed sharply from its August lows, attracting renewed attention from traders and investors.
Current market data shows ETH trading close to the $2,500 region, while recent price action has repeatedly tested the area around this psychological resistance. �
MetaMask +1
The significance of $2,500 goes beyond a simple round number. It represents an area where sellers have previously appeared, meaning a clean breakout and successful retest could give buyers additional confidence.
If ETH can establish several candles above this level rather than simply making a temporary spike, the market could begin treating $2,500 as a new support zone.
That would potentially open the door for the next major move.
🐂 Bulls Have Several Reasons to Stay Optimistic
One of the strongest arguments for Ethereum bulls is the improvement in institutional demand.
Recent data showed that U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs attracted approximately $697.2 million during the five trading sessions through August 21, while Bitcoin ETFs brought in approximately $1.918 billion. Together, the two markets recorded their strongest weekly inflows of 2026. �
CryptoSlate
ETF flows matter because they provide a channel through which traditional investors can gain exposure to crypto without directly holding the underlying asset.
If strong inflows continue, they could provide an important source of demand for ETH.
Another bullish development is continued accumulation by large corporate holders.
BitMine recently purchased approximately 32,447 ETH worth around $81.2 million, its largest single-week addition since early July, according to reporting cited by CoinDesk. �
CoinDesk +1
Large purchases do not guarantee that ETH will rise, but they can strengthen the broader narrative that major investors remain interested in Ethereum at current levels.
⚠️ The $2,500 Level Is Still a Major Test
Despite the bullish momentum, traders should not assume that breaking $2,500 automatically means ETH will immediately enter a new parabolic rally.
The market has already shown that $2,500 can attract selling pressure.
Recent technical analysis places the area around $2,500–$2,600 as an important resistance region. �
CryptoRank
This means ETH may need to consolidate around $2,400–$2,500 before attempting another breakout.
A strong move above $2,500 followed by a successful retest would be considerably more convincing than a quick wick above the level followed by a sharp rejection.
For bulls, the ideal scenario would look something like this:
Break $2,500 → Hold $2,500 → Retest $2,500 → Continue higher.
That type of structure could attract momentum traders and potentially accelerate the next leg upward.
🎯 What Could Be the Next ETH Targets?
If Ethereum successfully breaks and holds above $2,500, traders will likely begin watching the next resistance zones.
The first major area could be around $2,600. A sustained move above $2,600 would strengthen the breakout and could shift attention toward the $2,700 area.
Some current market analysis has identified approximately $2,700 as a potential upside target if ETH can maintain support around the low-$2,400s. �
TMGM
A stronger continuation could eventually bring the $2,800–$3,000 zone into focus.
However, these are potential technical levels—not guaranteed targets.
Crypto markets can move extremely quickly, especially after large rallies. Traders should therefore avoid treating price targets as promises.
🛡️ What If Ethereum Gets Rejected?
The bearish scenario is equally important.
If ETH repeatedly fails to break $2,500 and starts losing momentum, sellers could push the price back toward the lower support zones.
One important area to watch is around $2,350–$2,400. Recent analysis has identified approximately $2,356 as an important support level beneath the current market area. �
CoinDCX
A drop below that zone would weaken the immediate bullish structure and could indicate that the $2,500 breakout attempt was unsuccessful.
The key distinction is between a normal pullback and a trend reversal.
A controlled pullback that holds above major support could simply give buyers another opportunity to enter.
But if ETH begins making lower highs and lower lows while losing important support levels, traders may need to reconsider the bullish setup.
📊 ETH vs. Bitcoin: Why Ethereum Is Getting Attention
Bitcoin remains the dominant cryptocurrency, but Ethereum has recently shown impressive momentum.
The broader crypto market has benefited from renewed ETF demand, improving liquidity expectations and a weaker-dollar narrative. Bitcoin and Ethereum both experienced strong moves as investors returned to risk assets. �
CoinDesk
For Ethereum, however, the $2,500 breakout gives the market a clear technical story.
Traders now have an obvious level to watch.
Above $2,500: bullish confirmation.
Below $2,500: resistance remains active.
That simplicity can itself generate additional trading interest because both bulls and bears have a clearly defined battlefield.
🔥 The Biggest Question for ETH Traders
The biggest question is no longer whether Ethereum can reach $2,500.
It already did.
The question now is whether Ethereum can stay above $2,500 and turn the level into support.
That distinction is extremely important.
A temporary breakout can be caused by short-term momentum, leveraged positions or sudden buying pressure. A sustainable breakout usually requires follow-through.
If ETH can hold above $2,500 while trading volume remains strong and ETF demand continues, the probability of another upside attempt could increase.
On the other hand, if buyers repeatedly fail to defend the level, the market could enter another consolidation phase.
🚨 Final Takeaway
Ethereum has entered an important phase.
The recent rally, renewed ETF inflows and large ETH purchases have improved the bullish narrative. ETF data showed nearly $700 million of weekly inflows into Ethereum funds, while BitMine's latest purchase demonstrates continued interest from large holders. �
CryptoSlate +1
But the market still needs confirmation.
$2,500 is the key level.
A clean breakout and successful retest could put $2,600, $2,700 and potentially $2,800+ on the radar.
A rejection, however, could send ETH back toward the $2,350–$2,400 support area.
For traders, the smartest approach may be to watch the reaction around $2,500 rather than chase a sudden green candle.
Ethereum is not simply testing a price—it is testing market confidence.
If bulls win this battle and turn $2,500 into support, ETH could be setting up for another major move.
If bears defend the level, the market may need more time to build momentum.
The next few sessions could determine whether $2,500 becomes Ethereum's launchpad—or its ceiling.

title: 📊 ÚLTIMA SEMANA DE AGOSTO: REGULAÇÃO, JACKSON HOLE E A OFERTA DE TOKENS QUE VEM PELA FRENTE
subTitle:
📊 ÚLTIMA SEMANA DE AGOSTO: REGULAÇÃO, JACKSON HOLE E A OFERTA DE TOKENS QUE VEM PELA FRENTE
Fechamos agosto com o mercado cripto navegando entre dois sinais: o regulatório, lento mas em movimento real, e o de curto prazo, com eventos macro e desbloqueios de token concentrados nesta última semana do mês.

🏛️ O RCA: A SEC propõe um caminho mais claro
A SEC apresentou o Regulation Crypto Assets (RCA), pacote que cria vias específicas de oferta para tokens, em vez de depender só de formulários tradicionais ou de ações de execução caso a caso. Na prática: isenção para startups captarem até US$ 5 milhões em quatro anos, com divulgações no próprio site, além de faixas escalonadas de até US$ 20 milhões (Tier 1) e US$ 75 milhões (Tier 2) por ano, com exigências crescentes de reporte.
O detalhe mais relevante é o “porto seguro” condicional: quando o trabalho essencial de um projeto estiver concluído e a rede for suficientemente descentralizada, a venda contínua do token pode deixar de ser tratada como valor mobiliário. Isso tende a beneficiar ecossistemas com grande volume de lançamentos, como Ethereum e Solana, dando critério mais objetivo sobre quando um token “se descola” do status de security.
Mas atenção: o RCA ainda não é lei. Falta consulta pública de cerca de 60 dias e redação final da SEC. Em paralelo, o Congresso avalia o Digital Asset Market Clarity Act, mais amplo, que definiria a divisão de competências entre SEC e CFTC — com votação de cloture no Senado no radar.

📅 O que movimenta esta semana
Jackson Hole (27-29/ago): principal evento do Fed no ano, com poder real de mexer expectativa de juros e apetite por risco global.
PIB e PCE dos EUA: inflação e atividade econômica seguem como termômetro para leitura de política monetária — e, por tabela, para BTC e altcoins.
Resultado da Nvidia: mesmo sendo ação, costuma contaminar o humor de todo o setor de tecnologia e risco, cripto incluso.

⚠️ Desbloqueios de token — a semana mais pesada de agosto
Entre 24 e 30/08, estima-se cerca de US$ 706 milhões em emissões na semana. Cliff unlocks mais concentrados: Humanity (H) com ~US$ 18,53 mi (13,4% do supply liberado), Huma Finance (HUMA) com ~US$ 9,89 mi (26,5% de impacto — o mais sensível da lista), Plasma (XPL) com ~US$ 8,85 mi (3,3%) e SosoValue (SOSO) com ~US$ 7,32 mi (6,9%).
Nas emissões lineares diárias, destaque para BTC (~US$ 33,75 mi/dia), RAIN (~US$ 18,40 mi/dia), ETH (~US$ 6,38 mi/dia) e SOL (~US$ 6,02 mi/dia) — efeito mais diluído, mas relevante em momentos de sensibilidade de mercado. Vale o alerta técnico: unlock grande não é sinônimo automático de queda. O que importa é quem recebe (time, investidores, comunidade), qual fatia representa da oferta circulante, e a liquidez do ativo. Por isso HUMA, com 26,5% de impacto relativo, tende a pesar mais que XPL, mesmo com valor absoluto menor.

🔍 No radar cripto
Força recente do ETH segue sustentando o sentimento do mercado; o ataque à ponte Allbridge reacendeu discussão sobre risco em soluções cross-chain, tema sensível sempre que envolve movimentação de valor entre redes diferentes

🔮 O que esperar para setembro
Setembro chega como mês de definição em três frentes: o tom de Jackson Hole vai calibrar a expectativa de juros pro resto do ano; a consulta pública do RCA deve avançar, testando se a proposta sai como está ou sofre revisão; e o Senado pode finalmente votar o CLARITY Act, resolvendo (ou não) parte da incerteza sobre quem regula o quê no setor.

I’m leaning bullish. The logic is simple: Machi closing his BTC longs looks more like position rebalancing than a directional reversal—the remaining $94.92M in altcoins is the real stance. 我倾向看多。逻辑很简单：Machi平的是已经赚到的BTC多单，但9,492万美元的ETH和山寨仓位一动没动，这叫分批止盈，不叫逃跑。$79,000附近如果能站稳回踩确认，下一个阻力看整数关口上方；跌破$78,000则说明突破失败，回调整固时间会拉长。破位追高和破位割肉都不可取，等回踩确认更稳妥。
